beaches.name: Spiaggia naturista Nido dell'Aquila (Parco di Rimigliano)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is authorised on a signed 500 m stretch at Nido dell'Aquila. ANITA reports that Comune di San Vincenzo resolution n. 83 of 24 March 2010 designates this stretch of the Rimigliano park beach for naturist use and that signs placed by the Comune mark its limits; the resolution is not published on the Comune's own site. The authorisation applies only to the signed stretch.

beaches.name: Spiaggia della Lecciona (tratto naturista)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is authorised between rescue posts 13 and 15 at La Lecciona. Comune di Viareggio Giunta resolution n. 130 of 22 April 2022 establishes the stretch, inside the Migliarino–San Rossore–Massaciuccoli regional park between Viareggio and Torre del Lago, and requires it to remain free, open to all and marked with signs agreed with the park authority and ANITA. The resolution does not regulate the rest of the beach; ANITA reports signs at poles 13 and 15.
